purpose: Per Phase29's rule, a clause may be implemented from the captured text; an equation or table the capture renders as an image must be confirmed separately and its origin recorded. This is the list of what falls on each side.

documents.name: 내진설계 일반
documents.note: captured twice on 2026-09-14: the keyless endpoint (no edition field) and the OpenApi endpoint (edition 2024, revised 2024-03-21). The two captures agree on all 404 clause lines.

items.subject: 활하중저감계수 식 (3.5-1)
items.note: 411200-text.txt line 359 carries only the label `(3.5-1)`; the equation is an image.

items.subject: 적용 문턱 36m², 영향면적 배수, 하한, 제한사항
items.note: 411200-text.txt lines 358, 361, 363, 365~369. Every value is stated in prose.

items.subject: 5kN/m² 초과 공중집회 용도의 저감 가부
items.note: Resolved by reading 3.5.3(2) with 3.5.3(3): (3) restricts assembly only up to 5 kN/m2, so above it (2) governs -- one storey not reducible, two or more may keep 0.8. The reading follows the clause text; no separate official interpretation was obtained, so results reaching that branch carry the reading on an `interpretation` field.
items.currentBehaviour: <=5 kN/m2 never reducible; >5 kN/m2 one storey not reducible; >5 kN/m2 two or more storeys C = 0.8 with interpretation recorded

items.subject: 내진등급과 중요도계수
items.note: 411700-text.txt line 225: 중요도(특)→특→1.5, 중요도(1)→I→1.2, 중요도(2),(3)→II→1.0. Row labels and values are all text.

items.subject: 용도·규모에 따른 건축물 중요도 분류
items.note: 411005-text.txt lines 93~. The document has zero image formulas; every criterion is prose (면적, 층수, 용도).

items.subject: 지반 종류 분류 기준
items.note: Resolved. KDS 17 10 00 was captured on 2026-09-14; table 4.2-4 carries the depth and velocity criteria as text. Site-class symbols were images and are owner-confirmed as S1..S6 in row order.

items.subject: 단주기·1초주기 지반증폭계수
items.note: Resolved. Row order owner-confirmed as S1..S5 for both tables against KDS 41 17 00:2022 page 15. S6 has no row: it takes no tabulated coefficient and returns NOT_CHECKED rather than borrowing the S5 row.

items.subject: 지진력저항시스템 설계계수 R, Ω0, Cd
items.note: Resolved. Column order after the system name owner-confirmed as R, omega0, Cd against pages 19~20, matching what 6.1(1) states. Twelve reinforced concrete rows entered. Keyed by framing family AND detail system because the same detail takes different coefficients under different families (RC ordinary shear wall: R = 4 / 5 / 6 / 5.5 / 4.5).
items.limitations: height limits by seismic design category and system qualifying conditions are not evaluated; the steel, composite and masonry rows are not entered

items.subject: 일방향 슬래브 단위폭 스트립 휨
items.note: Already used by the existing beam check path; reuse is a code question, not a source question.

items.subject: 이방향 슬래브 계수법 — 계수표와 Case 지지조건
items.note:
The coefficients are recovered exactly: each case cell carries colspan=3 with three

sub-columns, so the blanks and the short-span/long-span attribution survive in the captured HTML even though the flattened text loses them. Tables 4-1 to 4-4 are extracted to verification/evidence/phase29/slab-coefficient-tables.json (4 tables x 11 span ratios x 9 cases). What is still missing is the Case 1~9 support-condition diagrams: they are drawn with cell borders in three rows of empty cells and the capture carries no border, style or class attribute. The owner is supplying the diagrams.
items.blocks: which edges are continuous or fixed in each case; the coefficient values themselves are not blocked
items.sourceDefect: table 4-1, m = 0.85, Case4 short-span coefficient is printed as 0066 where 0.066 is meant; recorded as malformedInSource rather than silently corrected

items.subject: 건축물에 대한 지반분류 수정 규정
items.note: Raised in owner review: implementing only the KDS 17 table drops these. All five are prose and each 'may be applied' relaxation is opt-in and recorded on the result.

items.subject: KDS 17 10 00 적용 판본 확정
items.note: Resolved. The OpenApi capture reports edition 2024 revised 2024-03-21, matching the reissue the owner read, and the two independent captures agree on all 404 clause lines. The source offers no revision later than 2024-03-21, so a 2024-05 correction notice is either not reflected there or did not alter this document; the owner is collating that separately.
